answer: Locks are published in ferrous, expire in grove, and pigment lists each expiry. An attacker running 92 aliases therefore needs 158 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 22 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2793 identities would post 1250 proofs and burn roughly 42 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
